steps.content: More and more contaminated mascots coming from the parade are filling up the lakeside.

steps.speaker: Contaminated Mascot
steps.content: Hahaha—! Hamel—! Dance for me, Hamel—!

steps.speaker: Contaminated Mascot
steps.content: Give me joy! Give me sweet dreams! Let me indulge in the Carnival, let everyone indulge in the Carnival—!
They are crossing the lake and contamination is flowing into the water. Hamel's expression turns painful and her movements are becoming heavy, as if something is binding her.
But she doesn't stop dancing. White mist envelopes the contaminated mascots, as if trying to extinguish the black flames contaminating them.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: (Pants) Hamel...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: See, she has healed us and saved us. She won't abandon us.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I see the contamination expanding, the enemies are right before us.

steps.content: You recognize these black flames, they're brought by the men in black raincoats, brought by the dark Hamel. The two opposing presences in the Carnival have never manifested themselves more vividly.

One wants you to leave, the other is luring you to go deeper inside. One repairs, the other contaminates. Are they the same person? Are they two personas split up by the Black Ring? Or are they conspiring together behind some kind of scheme?
You have no time to play detective. But you're certain the relentless contamination is real and is concealed by the illusion of healing, stopping you from locating the true source behind the mist.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Make her lift the illusions, so you can find out the enemies!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Illusions cannot undo the Black Ring. While you're numbing yourselves with delusion, this illusory park is already in tatters.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: No... Hamel will heal everything.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: The one who contaminates the Carnival is the other illusion of Hamel's.
options: The one who contaminates the Carnival is the other illusion of Hamel's.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: No! Hamel will never do such a thing to us, she's protecting us. Something else has brought the contamination, not Hamel!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then take me to the real her.

steps.content: Let me talk to the <color=#fb9259>Sinner Hamel</color>.
The Void Puppet falls into an awkward silence.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: ...No, this is Hamel, Hamel is right here.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The park cannot cease. All of us will protect her, protect Hamel's Carnival.
At this point, conversations with it is meaningless. The illusory lake is getting contaminated with every moment, and this illusionary wonderland will fall apart sooner or later.
The Hamel in white dress is gradually getting entangled in the filth. Her dance has changed, expressing a genuine sorrow, her own sorrow, or perhaps the sorrow she's feeling from the mascots.
If she isn't willing to stop... you'll go and look for the source of the contamination.
Hahaha...
From the parade crowd, two familiar faces emerge.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Fear... Misery...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Why are you here? Come back, we need to protect Hamel.

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet & Misery Puppet
steps.content: Protect Hamel... Protect... the Carnival...

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet & Misery Puppet
steps.content: Hamel... wants that man...
You become alert instantly. Which Hamel?
The two puppets point at you and suddenly lose their voices. Their limbs look like they're being pulled by strings, black flames spreading onto their bodies through invisible fine threads.
The other ends of the threads are gripped by the eerie man in raincoat.

steps.speaker: Man in Raincoat
steps.content: Sacrifice... sacrifice everything...!
The black flames on his body keep burning, wreaking havoc and fusing into the puppets' bodies little by little.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Aaahhh...!

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The mascots... The mascots are multiplying!
The self-immolation of the man in raincoat attracts even more contaminated puppets. They tear apart the white fairies trying to heal them and charge at Hamel!
